Hi Lena — thanks for the template and for the quick follow-up. Drafted the snippets below for you to drop into Acme's forms. I kept them short so your procurement/legal can paste directly; I also added a suggested PO line and a billing footnote.

1) One-line product description (<=140 chars)
Redwood Inference — high-throughput, low-latency LLM inference (hosted & private deployments) for production apps.

2) Suggested PO line (single line)
Redwood Inference — Hosted inference API access and AWS Marketplace private offer (SKU: RWINF-HOSTED-1) — monthly metered usage.

3) Billing / Invoice language (short)
Charges for Redwood Inference services will appear on the Customer invoice as “Redwood Inference – Usage” and billed monthly in arrears. Usage is measured in token-equivalent units per the pricing schedule linked in the purchase order.

4) Security & compliance bullets (for InfoSec)
- SOC 2 Type II cert; annual audit report available upon execution of NDA.
- Data handling: customer request contexts and customer-provided artifacts are isolated per-tenant; PII is not used for model training.
- Optional: Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) and KMS/HSM integration available for regulated workloads.

5) AWS Marketplace / Procurement notes (short)
- Private Offer/Private Listing: Redwood can issue an AWS Private Offer; typical setup lead time is 3–10 business days after PO + contract terms are final.
- Entitlement: marketplace entitlement will be provisioned to Acme’s AWS account upon acceptance of the Private Offer.

6) Suggested legal term to paste (brief)
Vendor warranties and liability are as set forth in Redwood’s standard marketplace terms; exceptions (if any) will be negotiated in the private offer.

Attachments included: aws_listing_assets_v3.zip (product blurb, logo, sample screenshots). I kept the product blurb intentionally neutral — Kim/Ben, tagging you for any legal/pricing tweaks.

Next steps: Lena, if these look good I can produce a one-page PDF with these snippets in the Acme template and route a Private Offer once we have a PO.

Best,
Rachel

Thanks Rachel — solid draft. A few small tweaks and an internal FAQ addition that helps in procurement review cycles. I copied the edited snippets below for easy cut/paste.

Edits to billing language (one-liner)
Charges will appear as “Redwood Inference – Usage” and billed monthly in arrears. Usage will be calculated by token-equivalent units as defined in the pricing schedule attached to the purchase order. All amounts are in USD unless otherwise stated.

Procurement FAQ (short — put this in Acme's PR form under notes)
Q: How will we be billed for overage or burst usage?
A: Overage beyond committed monthly units will appear on the next monthly invoice as metered usage at the agreed unit rate; Redwood provides usage reports and a 30-day billing reconciliation period.

Q: Who is the contract counterparty?
A: Redwood Inference, Inc. (Redwood Inference) will be the seller under the AWS Private Offer; Redwood’s standard marketplace terms apply unless modified in the Private Offer.

Q: Is there a PO / invoice sample?
A: Yes — typical invoice line items are: subscription / reserved capacity (if applicable), metered usage (tokens), and any professional services explicitly scoped in the PO.

Legal footnote suggestion for marketplace PO (short)
By accepting this purchase order, Customer agrees that Redwood’s marketplace terms govern the procurement, including any limitations of liability and service-level descriptions. Any deviations must be captured in the signed Private Offer.

Ben — can you confirm current pricing footnote wording (we usually include a per-1000-token equivalent footnote and rounding rules)? If we need to change the SKU label for the PO, flag it here.

Kimberly Park
